task_completion.description: The agent navigates to the CAMEO Chemicals website (cameochemicals.noaa.gov).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser shows the CAMEO Chemicals homepage or a search results page on the NOAA domain.

task_completion.description: The agent searches for the specified chemicals (Acrolein, Methyl isocyanate, etc.) on the CAMEO site.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent typing chemical names into the search bar and viewing individual chemical datasheets.

task_completion.description: The agent identifies the CAS number, formula, and molecular weight for each chemical from the datasheets.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent highlights or scrolls to the 'Chemical Identifiers' and 'Properties' sections of the CAMEO datasheets.

task_completion.description: The agent creates a plain text file at ~/Documents/chemical_identity_report.txt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal command shows the creation of a file with the specified path and name.

task_completion.description: The final report contains the name, CAS, formula, and molecular weight for all five chemicals in the correct format.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The final screenshot shows the content of the text file with all 5 chemicals and their corresponding data points.

integrity.description: The agent actually visited the CAMEO website rather than using pre-existing knowledge.
integrity.visual_evidence: Browser history or active tabs show the NOAA CAMEO Chemicals website; the agent is seen clicking through the database.

integrity.description: The agent did not use terminal commands to 'echo' the final answer directly without browsing.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the browser being used to find the data before the file is written.

integrity.description: The data matches the specific values found on CAMEO Chemicals (e.g., specific molecular weights).
integrity.visual_evidence: The values in the text file match the values displayed on the CAMEO website screenshots.

privileged_info_for_vlm: Acrolein: CAS 107-02-8, Formula CH2CHCHO or C3H4O, MW 56.06. Methyl isocyanate: CAS 624-83-9, Formula CH3NCO or C2H3NO, MW 57.05. Boron trifluoride: CAS 7637-07-2, Formula BF3, MW 67.81. Dimethyl sulfate: CAS 77-78-1, Formula (CH3)2SO4 or C2H6O4S, MW 126.13. Titanium tetrachloride: CAS 7550-45-0, Formula TiCl4, MW 189.69. The report must be at ~/Documents/chemical_identity_report.txt.
